name: Monaco
summary: Very strict: using drugs or possessing them for own use is punishable by 6 months–3 years prison (Law 890). Using drugs in a group is punished like trafficking (5–10 years). No known drug checking.
callingForHelp: No specific legal protection found. Note that group drug use is itself a serious offence in Monaco; emergency medical staff are bound by medical secrecy.
drugChecking: No drug checking service known in Monaco.

loi890.title: Law No. 890 of 1 July 1970 on narcotics (Legimonaco)

lsd.note: Internationally controlled. Use or possession for own use: 6 months–3 years prison and/or fine; group use punished like trafficking.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is internationally controlled; mushrooms are presumably covered as in France (not verified). Own use: 6 months–3 years.

dmt.note: Internationally controlled; ayahuasca therefore illegal. Own use: 6 months–3 years prison.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is internationally controlled; status of cacti not verified.

dox.note: DOM, DOB and DOC are internationally controlled.

nbomes.note: 25B-, 25C- and 25I-NBOMe are internationally controlled; other analogues not verified.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is internationally controlled; other 2C-x not verified.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not internationally controlled; Monaco's ministerial list could not be checked.

cannabis.note: Use or possession for own use: 6 months–3 years prison and/or fine; group use punished like trafficking (5–10 years).

ketamine.note: Medicine; likely classified as in France (stupéfiant) but not verified. Possession without prescription is risky.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is widely controlled (EU-wide since 2014); Monaco's ministerial list could not be checked.

dxm.note: Not a controlled drug internationally; Monegasque prescription rules not verified (in France it is prescription-only).

nitrous.note: No Monegasque rule found; French rules do not apply automatically.

amphetamines.note: Internationally controlled; own use 6 months–3 years prison. Prescription stimulants only with a prescription.

mdma.note: Internationally controlled. Own use: 6 months–3 years prison; using in a group is punished like trafficking.

cocaine.note: Internationally controlled. Own use: 6 months–3 years; supply 5–10 years, production/import 10–20 years.

alcohol.note: Legal for adults; rules on sales to minors exist but the exact age limit was not verified.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is internationally controlled; status of GBL/1,4-BD not verified.

opioids.note: Heroin is banned; prescription opioids are controlled medicines. Own use: 6 months–3 years prison.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine (status as narcotic not verified).

benzodiazepines.note: Internationally controlled psychotropic medicines; prescription only.

maois.note: Prescription-only medicines; ayahuasca is illegal (DMT); harmala status not verified.
